notes.title: Dark Age Dinos - Summer Update
notes.notes:
Hey Dark Age Dinos lovers!

We've got another small update to the demo to tide you over for the summer.



Rewards are now delivered via shiny chests



All spell and impact VFX have been improved



You'll leave evidence of your carnage



The map has been spruced up to show some full release points of interest



And of course, additional bug fixes



Don't forget to share your feedback with us via the Feedback button in game. Dark Age Dinos can only reach its full potential with help from players, like yourselves!

notes.title: Dark Age Dinos - Spring Update
notes.notes:
Spring is in the air! Our team has emerged from hibernation bearing a new demo update for you all to enjoy over your spring breaks. Once again this update is just too large to give an exhaustive list, but here are some of the headlines:


 Cretacia’s shopkeepers got an extra large order of healing flasks recently and they’re practically giving them away. You can now buy back used flasks from any shop
 A local shopkeeper recently got a killer deal on some property behind the demo’s miniboss. There will always be a shop after the miniboss on the map
 Speaking of the miniboss, they spent the winter learning how to keep warm. Be on your guard for a new meteor attack
 The Dinosaur Combat Union has ratified an agreement to add more space between tiles. It’s never been easier to tell where your foe begins and your ally ends
 Everybody must have been parched before those flasks. You’ll find your party and the demo’s boss are much more talkative these days


Of course, that’s not all we’ve been working on. Internally, our full launch roster has been finalized and playtesters have been loving the new character classes. We can’t wait to share them with you all soon (TM). In the meantime, here’s a little teaser:
